RANGPUR, June 26, 2023 (BSS) - Import and export activities will remain suspended for six days from June 27 to July 2 next through Hili Land Port (HLP) under Hakimpur upazila in Dinajpur on occasion of the Eid-ul-Azha festivity.

General Secretary of the Customs, Clearing and Forwarding Agents Association of HLP Jamil Hossain Cholonto said import and export activities will remain suspended through the land port during the period.
